title: Chapter 2 Stage 0 Post-VTT Rulings
lede: Four gm-assist.md judgments remain after checking the fresh Codex audit against the spell-pass-cleaned, speaker-labelled VTT. The chapter document is corroboration only because it spans three sessions.
footer: Applied without asking: one mechanical quote-order correction in gm-assist.md, restoring the Soma / Vukradin / Soma order from cleaned VTT cues 1524-1526. Nine other audit candidates required no change because the current wording is supported, defensible, or covered by an earlier explicit ruling.

items.t: Remove Valphine-derived hardship and pain motivation from Soma's introduction.
items.y: Edit gm-assist.md:10 so Soma is described as an elderly wilderness guide in her sunset years, without claiming that hardship and raw experience keep her old bones alive. Valphine retains the danger-and-pain motivation.
items.n: Leave gm-assist.md:10 unchanged, preserving a motive for Soma that the cleaned transcript assigns to Valphine.
items.ev: The cleaned VTT establishes Soma as a guide in her sunset years at cues 365-370. It assigns hardship and self-inflicted pain to Valphine at cues 629-638 and 819-833.

items.t: Separate Norbus's site introduction, the party's Religion lore, and Dazlyn's confirmation.
items.y: Edit gm-assist.md:20, :126, and :153: Norbus identifies the buried settlement and temple; the successful Religion check supplies the sacrifices, earthquake, and avalanche lore; Dazlyn confirms it. This removes the recap's exclusive attribution to Dazlyn.
items.n: Leave those passages unchanged, continuing to credit Dazlyn or the two prospectors with historical details supplied through the party's Religion check.
items.ev: Cleaned VTT cues 1538-1549 have Norbus introduce the site and Abbathor temple. Cues 1567-1570 deliver the sacrifice and disaster lore through the successful check, followed by Dazlyn's confirmation.

items.t: Qualify the side passage as appearing to loop back toward the entrance.
items.y: Edit gm-assist.md:24, :68, and :135 from a confirmed loop to a passage that appeared to loop back. This preserves that the party inferred the route from the revealed map but did not traverse it.
items.n: Leave the three passages unchanged and treat the map-visible direction as sufficient to state that the passage looped back.
items.ev: At cleaned VTT cues 1911-1915, the party says it looks like the passage takes them back and the GM confirms only that it leads north; they do not complete the route.

items.t: Change Soma's Goodberry entry from definitely prepared to considered preparing.
items.y: Edit gm-assist.md:192 to say Soma considered preparing Goodberry and discussed replacing Longstrider or Ice Knife. This preserves the uncertainty in the speaker-labelled exchange.
items.n: Leave the entry as 'Soma prepared this spell,' reading the proposed removal of Longstrider followed by 'Ice Knife, I'm never going to use that' as an implied completed preparation change.
items.ev: Cleaned VTT cues 1304-1314 confirm that Goodberry is on the Druid list and record: 'I could prepare Goodberries,' 'I'll take off ... Longstrider,' then 'Ice Knife, I'm never going to use that.' No later cue explicitly confirms the final list.
